podcast.title: Rediscovery and Re-evaluation
podcast.body: Lucia Pamela's outsider music record was rediscovered, reissued, and subsequently re-evaluated by prominent critics, including writers from The New York Times and David Bowie. Lucia herself considered her work to be a very serious artistic statement, not a novelty. "Here's another outsider music record that was rediscovered, reissued, and subsequently re-evaluated by critics ranging from the writers of the New York Times to David Bowie."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Serious Artistic Statement
podcast.body: Despite potential perceptions of her music as a novelty, Lucia Pamela firmly believed her recordings were serious artistic statements. This conviction underscores the internal drive and self-perception often found among outsider musicians. "Lucia believed that to be a very serious artistic statement."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
